messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert -> private-gateway-prod: sudden spike in 504s and backend timeouts. error-rate > 8% across eu-west-1 gateways, customer-facing inference calls failing. Paging oncall.

pagerduty: @Ajay paged (P1). Escalation to netinfra if not ACK in 2 min.

Ajay (oncall): acked, jumping in. seeing 504s routed through nat-gw-03 -> many connections in TIME_WAIT. Will pull logs.

Derek (prodops): support dashboards show ~40% of requests from onboarding customers 504-ing since 12:00. No model deploys.

Maria (netinfra): any infra rollouts in the last 30m? I see an automated firewall policy rollout started 11:58 targeting security-group sg-0a1b2c3d (egress rules). Could be related.

Lee (infra): confirmed - rollout job fw-rollout-2026-03-15 hit 4 ASGs incl private-gateway-asg at 11:59. Change: added egress deny for 0.0.0.0/0 except allowed list.

Ajay (oncall): that sounds relevant — asymmetric traffic might be dropping return packets. Can someone run a quick check on conntrack and iptables on GW nodes?

Lee (infra): running: 
```
ssh gw-03
sudo conntrack -S | grep entries
sudo iptables -t nat -L -n -v
```
conntrack shows ~120k entries, ephemeral ports near exhaustion, but more important iptables NAT MASQUERADE chain appears fine. However `dmesg` shows "nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet" repeated.

Maria (netinfra): that matches conntrack exhaustion. The new egress deny probably caused many short-lived retries from clients to other regions which filled conntrack table. We need immediate mitigation: roll back the fw rollout on private-gateway-asg and increase conntrack for gateway nodes.

Ajay (oncall): immediate actions: 1) rollback fw-rollout-2026-03-15 for target ASG 2) bump conntrack on gateways 3) validate customer traffic. I'm doing rollback now.

Lee (infra): rolling back rule set for ASG private-gateway-asg -> reverting sg-0a1b2c3d to previous egress policy. ETA ~90s.

Sophia (support): notifying affected customers that we have engineers on it, working on mitigation. sample ticket IDs: #C-4382, #C-4383.

Derek (prodops): testing inference endpoint behind gw-03: `curl -v https://private-gateway-prod/model/health` -> before rollback timed out, retrying after rollback...

Derek (prodops): after rollback -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK, latency 120ms :thumbsup:

Lee (infra): conntrack table still high. Increasing net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max from 262144 -> 524288 on gw-*. Applying via sysctl now.

Lee (infra): sysctl applied across gw fleet. Monitoring. conntrack count dropping as TIME_WAIT clears.

Ajay (oncall): confirm error rate trending down?

incident-bot: metrics -> 504 rate decreased from 8.3% to 0.7% over 3 minutes post-rollback.

Sophia (support): customers showing recoveries in dashboards and support threads updated. Sending follow-up message to impacted customers.

Maria (netinfra): next steps: 1) postmortem to capture why fw-rollout targeted gateway ASG, 2) add rollout guard to prevent egress deny on gateway groups, 3) tune conntrack proactively and add alert when conntrack > 80%.

Ajay (oncall): handing off to Maria for follow-up and postmortem. I'm going to sleep; monitoring looks stable.

Maria (netinfra): taking ownership for post-incident. Will create postmortem and coordinate with infra and release team. Thanks everyone.

pagerduty: incident acknowledged by Maria, status: monitoring.

Ajay (oncall): final note: probably root cause = policy rollout accidentally included gateway ASG. Impact = transient customer 504s/timeouts. Mitigation = rollback + conntrack bump. Action items assigned in ticket INFRA-1187.

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> moving to status: recovered. Please file postmortem within 48h.
